tools.name: search
tools.title: Search MusicDNA catalog
tools.description: Find catalog songs by title, artist or verified release title. Returns up to 20 identity matches; use catalog_search_songs for complete cursor pagination.

tools.name: fetch
tools.title: Fetch MusicDNA catalog song
tools.description: Read an exact song item returned by search, including canonical scores, associated explanations and provenance. This does not fetch private interview traces.

tools.name: get_profile
tools.title: get profile
tools.description: Use this when identify your own connected MusicDNA operator account and current permissions. Does not enumerate other users.

tools.name: catalog_get_summary
tools.title: catalog get summary
tools.description: Use this when audit authoritative catalog/Why counts and coverage. Unrecorded model rejection statistics are explicitly unavailable.

tools.name: catalog_list_songs
tools.title: catalog list songs
tools.description: Use this when page the catalog with stable IDs and owner/filter-bound cursors. Genre means catalog primary lane; ordering is stable by ID.

tools.name: catalog_get_song
tools.title: catalog get song
tools.description: Use this when read one complete authoritative song, scores, associated explanations and catalog pairings. Missing provenance is not inferred.

tools.name: catalog_search_songs
tools.title: catalog search songs
tools.description: Use this when search titles/artists by normalized title/artist, punctuation/diacritics and partial/fuzzy trigram matching, with stable IDs and heuristic match confidence. Includes verified artwork-release titles; does not assert unique album/recording identity.

tools.name: catalog_get_song_attributes
tools.title: catalog get song attributes
tools.description: Use this when inspect the existing ten dimension scores, poles, provenance and supporting explanations for one song. No new scoring engine or confidence is invented.

tools.name: catalog_get_attribute_ontology
tools.title: catalog get attribute ontology
tools.description: Use this when retrieve the live axes definitions/poles and shared numeric scale; unrecorded versions/thresholds remain unavailable.

tools.name: song_whys_get_summary
tools.title: song whys get summary
tools.description: Use this when audit saved explanation status/attribute/genre/decade counts. Human approval/rejection is distinct from model reviewer outcomes.

tools.name: song_whys_list
tools.title: song whys list
tools.description: Use this when retrieve complete saved Song Whys with exact score/ontology and honest provenance, one cursor page at a time; continue until next_cursor is null.

tools.name: song_whys_get
tools.title: song whys get
tools.description: Use this when inspect a complete saved explanation and review_context_version before a paid re-review. Includes original/current score, authoritative definition, catalog recording identity and honest uncertainty; review_policy describes current v2 Pass / Fail / Uncertain criteria without a model call.

tools.name: song_whys_request_ai_review
tools.title: song whys request ai review
tools.description: Use this when explicitly re-review ONE selected saved explanation (approved included) with the configured reviewer under saved-song-why-review-v2: Pass / Fail / Uncertain. Missing audio alone is uncertainty, not failure or a score dispute. PAID: obtain explicit human confirmation for this exact version/context before confirm_paid_review=true. Use song_whys_get first. One 20-second / 2,000-output-token attempt, no writer, no automatic retry. Reuse mutation_id after any lost response; the existing ten-new-requests-per-caller-per-rolling-hour cap still applies. Historical v1 reviews, text, scores and approvals remain unchanged. Read-only access does not authorize this tool.

tools.name: song_whys_get_ai_review
tools.title: song whys get ai review
tools.description: Use this when read one saved advisory AI-review request/result with original text and score, immutable version/context, new findings, nullable suggested score, measurements and separate stale flags. Does not start model work.

tools.name: song_whys_list_ai_reviews
tools.title: song whys list ai reviews
tools.description: Use this when page saved AI-review results by policy and pass/fail/uncertain verdict, separately from operational state and nullable score suggestions. Findings are new audit records, never retroactive historical verdicts. Does not run an AI review; rule-based song_whys_run_audit is separate.

tools.name: song_whys_get_ai_review_rates
tools.title: song whys get ai review rates
tools.description: Use this when read separate failure and uncertainty rates for one review policy and optionally a selected cohort. Counts latest attempt per explanation, completed reviews only in rate denominators; unavailable attempts and older policies remain separate. A 90% v1 failure outcome is not a verified 90% catalog-error rate. Empty denominators return null. No paid calls.

tools.name: song_whys_export
tools.title: song whys export
tools.description: Use this when start or advance an asynchronous complete JSON/CSV export. Start requires a fresh idempotency key. Status advances the queued snapshot job. Ready links expire and require the SAME account and current catalog permission; no records are truncated inline.

tools.name: song_whys_get_review_history
tools.title: song whys get review history
tools.description: Use this when retrieve only recorded baseline/revisions/review snapshots. Never reconstruct absent older drafts or model reviews.

tools.name: song_whys_run_audit
tools.title: song whys run audit
tools.description: Use this when run independent rule-based text/catalog screening without changing content or calling an AI model. Hear claims always require listening; assistant must independently inspect returned evidence before suggesting wording.

tools.name: song_whys_find_conflicts
tools.title: song whys find conflicts
tools.description: Use this when inspect complete explanations on the same song for potential opposing audible descriptions. Returns exact excerpts/IDs as hypotheses requiring listening, not proven contradictions.

tools.name: song_whys_submit_revision
tools.title: song whys submit revision
tools.description: Use this when submit a version-bound draft to the existing human Admin Song Whys review queue. Requires explicit confirmation and an idempotency key. NEVER overwrites, approves or publishes the original.

tools.name: song_whys_record_audit_findings
tools.title: song whys record audit findings
tools.description: Use this when explicitly save evidence-bound audit findings without changing explanation approval. Repeated unresolved findings deduplicate; an idempotency key prevents duplicate writes.

tools.name: song_whys_list_audit_findings
tools.title: song whys list audit findings
tools.description: Use this when page saved unresolved/resolved audit findings; no result does not establish that explanations passed an audit.

tools.name: pairings_list
tools.title: pairings list
tools.description: Use this when browse canonical pairings and exact current song scores/years with deterministic cursor pagination.

tools.name: pairings_get_summary
tools.title: pairings get summary
tools.description: Use this when measure catalog pairing coverage, validation gaps and year differences. No private exposure/skip denominator is inferred.

tools.name: pairings_get
tools.title: pairings get
tools.description: Use this when read one exact catalog pairing with current songs, declared tests and shared activation diagnostics; historical choices remain frozen separately.

tools.name: pairings_validate_decade_proximity
tools.title: pairings validate decade proximity
tools.description: Use this when check exact nearest-opening-year distances against a configurable diagnostic window. The real selector uses a soft broader era preference, not this strict rule; this tool changes no production matching.

tools.name: pairings_find_for_song
tools.title: pairings find for song
tools.description: Use this when find diagnostic candidate matchups near one catalog opening song. Eligibility is a read-only year/integrity check, not a promise that live routing selects it.

tools.name: pairings_simulate_interview
tools.title: pairings simulate interview
tools.description: Use this when run six deterministic offline picks using shared selectPairing/applyChoice/preferEra functions and supplied context. No database writes or model calls. Not full production bootstrap/router/LLM parity.

tools.name: pairings_analyze_quality
tools.title: pairings analyze quality
tools.description: Use this when analyze complete current catalog coverage, diagnostic integrity and year gaps without claiming unmeasured live skip/mismatch rates.

tools.name: qa_list_interviews
tools.title: qa list interviews
tools.description: Use this when page ONLY authorized interview metadata. owner_qa is an operator tag, never proof of independent synthetic evidence.

tools.name: qa_get_interview_trace
tools.title: qa get interview trace
tools.description: Use this when read an authorized session and one cursor page of its frozen choices or trusted metadata events. No private chat, profiles, prompts or local-only raw critic traces.

tools.name: qa_get_critic_response
tools.title: qa get critic response
tools.description: Use this when inspect exact attempt metadata and any linked immutable accepted saved reading. Local-only raw writer/reviewer prose, rejected drafts and private messages are never exported.

tools.name: qa_get_reviewer_results
tools.title: qa get reviewer results
tools.description: Use this when page exact human rubric reviews for authorized sessions. Do not equate these with model review acceptance or independent randomized results.

tools.name: qa_get_reading
tools.title: qa get reading
tools.description: Use this when replay an exact saved reading (or latest) with deterministic ledger annotations from frozen choices only. Never regenerates, changes an archetype or exposes self-report/chat text.

tools.name: qa_validate_reading
tools.title: qa validate reading
tools.description: Use this when independently recompute existing ledger/claim-policy evidence from frozen choices for a saved result. Prose accuracy still needs the assistant/listener; no model verification is fabricated.

tools.name: qa_get_processing_timeline
tools.title: qa get processing timeline
tools.description: Use this when page measured model-attempt durations for an authorized session. Call duration sums are not wall-clock latency; missing phase timestamps/context/save timings remain unavailable.

tools.name: qa_get_quip_timeline
tools.title: qa get quip timeline
tools.description: Use this when inspect stored client-reported display metadata only. No display events means unavailable, not zero quips; static pools/server-generated lines are never reconstructed as actual display history.

tools.name: qa_analyze_quip_pacing
tools.title: qa analyze quip pacing
tools.description: Use this when analyze only recorded authorized quip display events, never source-code timers. Current historical telemetry may be absent; return unavailable metrics rather than inventing a timeline.

tools.name: qa_get_errors
tools.title: qa get errors
tools.description: Use this when page sanitized attempt status/reason codes for authorized sessions; raw provider errors/prompts are withheld and a failed diagnostic read is never a healthy empty check.

tools.name: qa_run_synthetic_interview
tools.title: qa run synthetic interview
tools.description: Use this when run an OFFLINE shared-engine synthetic diagnostic with six supplied choices, no persisted sessions/votes, no learning and no model spend. Full model quality/latency tests need a separately approved isolated provider harness.

tools.name: models_get_routing_summary
tools.title: models get routing summary
tools.description: Use this when inspect actual configured provider/role defaults and existing policy versions without credentials or a model call. Saved per-call measurements override assumptions about effective routing.

tools.name: models_get_quality_metrics
tools.title: models get quality metrics
tools.description: Use this when compute measured engineering counters for an explicit UTC window over authorized attempts. Missing tokens/cost/phase timings stay unavailable; denominators and sampling scope are explicit.

tools.name: models_compare_versions
tools.title: models compare versions
tools.description: Use this when compare two stored writer configurations in one explicit UTC window, with sample sizes and no invented statistical significance or causality.

tools.name: models_get_learning_signals
tools.title: models get learning signals
tools.description: Use this when page minimal local learning outbox/delivery receipts for authorized sessions. Dispatch/receipt acknowledgement is not EdgeBot model completion, Agent Brain learning or Echelon approval/application.
